name: 2D-GES Anti-Aliasing via Object Space Filtering
definition: An anti-aliasing technique for 2D Gaussian splatting that avoids screen-space filters by back-projecting the screen-space EWA filter into object space, implemented as a scaling adjustment of the 2D Gaussians.
summary: This training-free anti-aliasing technique for 2D Gaussian Splatting back-projects screen-space filters into object space to adjust Gaussian scaling, avoiding screen-space filtering limitations.
